question: dame el número de pagos válidos por tipo de financiación de la tarjeta, ordenado de más a menos
sql: SELECT dim_card.funding_type, count(DISTINCT v_payment_intent.payment_intent_id) AS num_pagos_validos FROM v_payment_intent JOIN dim_card ON v_payment_intent.card_sk = dim_card.card_sk WHERE v_payment_intent.eventually_approved GROUP BY dim_card.funding_type ORDER BY num_pagos_validos DESC
